g.title: CurrentSystem
g.text: Current GPU model — streamed storage + throughput instrumentation
N20K-SYS-0.1 — host, ordered execution, shared SDRAM and independent scanout

g.title: cluster_cpu
g.text: Host CPU / driver — outside simulated GPU execution time

g.title: cluster_device
g.text: Current device model — one common 100.8 MHz core / SDR clock (configured assumption)

g.title: cluster_link
g.text: Clocked host interface — no direct C++ pass injection

g.title: cluster_execution
g.text: Ordered executor — exactly one command operation active; branches are alternatives

g.title: cluster_memory
g.text: Shared memory subsystem — six bounded client ports, one physical SDR data bus

g.title: cluster_scanout
g.text: Independent scanout — continues while the ordered executor renders or waits

g.text: then separate FENCE and PRESENT commands

g.title: execute
g.text: Select one operation; retain its lease

g.text: Fetch descriptor, table, refs and records
Load / draw / drain / store all 300 tiles

g.title: trace
g.text: Distinct accept and retire IDs; stage / enable / occupancy
Common-clock CSV traces and cadence / latency histograms
Adds no GPU registers, queues or ports

g.title: front
g.text: Front is read-only to draws / copies
Old front becomes back after swap

g.title: slots
g.text: Held response keeps its slot occupied

g.title: arbitration
g.text: One active request runs to completion

g.title: controller
g.text: Short / unaligned requests still pay BL8

g.title: timing
g.text: Startup stays black until valid memory

g.text: one RGB565 write / edge; slot-read bubbles

g.text: SDL / S-key screenshot show actual FIFO output
Observer images are not GPU memory

g.title: limits
g.text: Serial rendering / single active command; no 1-pixel-per-cycle textured pipeline
CPU wide validation checks are simulation assertions, not timed GPU units
29 native BSRAM =12 original +12 client slots +2 reader +3 row staging
Small fields / masks / arithmetic mapped to bounded registers or logic ROM
Whole-system LUT / FF fit and achieved clock remain unproven
Solid teal: data / request-response. Dashed blue: control. Dotted purple: shared resource.
